name: @hasna/trash
description: Reversible deletion for agents - deletes land in a trash store, sync to cloud, expire on a chosen retention

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts src/sdk.ts --outdir dist --target bun && bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun && bun build src/serve/index.ts --outdir dist/serve --target bun && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run contract:check
scripts.scan:artifact: bun pm pack --ignore-scripts --quiet --filename "$PWD/trash-artifact-scan.tgz" && bunx @hasna/contracts@0.11.1 artifact-scan trash-artifact-scan.tgz; rc=$?; rm -f "$PWD/trash-artifact-scan.tgz"; exit $rc
scripts.prepack: bun run verify && bun run scan:artifact
